RULE-006.title: Department edits use optimistic concurrency (first save wins)
RULE-006.note: First save wins, with a deliberate overwrite that works. Block a save made with a stale RowVersion, show 'Current value: X' next to each conflicting field, and let a second Save overwrite. The legacy second save fails because HiddenFor re-posts the stale RowVersion; the rewrite must fix this (refresh the token). A delete made with a stale RowVersion is blocked the same way.
